attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will play automatically.

attributes.name: autoScroll
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will scroll continuously.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Slide duration in milliseconds. (Only used with `autoplay`)

attributes.name: fullBleed
attributes.description: If set, the slideshow will take up the width of its parent container showing previous and next slides. **Note:** a parent container must have `overflow-x: hidden` to prevent horizontal scrolling.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will loop back to the first slide after reaching the last slide.

attributes.name: navigation
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will display navigation arrows for previous and next slides when the slide container is hovered.

attributes.name: pagination
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will display pagination dots for each slide. If autoplay is on, the active dot will also show a progress bar.

attributes.name: pauseLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label for the pause button.

attributes.name: playLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label for the play button.

attributes.name: playOnInit
attributes.description: If true, the slideshow will start playing automatically on page load when `autoplay` or `autoScroll` are on.

attributes.name: scrollSpeed
attributes.description: Number of pixels auto scroll should advance per frame. (Only used with `autoScroll`)

attributes.name: startDelay
attributes.description: Delay in milliseconds before the auto scroll starts. (Only used with `autoScroll`)

members.description:

declarations.description:
The auro-slideshow component is a customizable slideshow that displays a series of slides
with several options such as autoplay, navigation controls, and pagination dots.
